Matterwave Ventures continues investment in Headmade Materials as Jet Investment Group leads a new funding round

Matterwave Ventures is reaffirming its commitment to Headmade Materials, the German deep tech startup transforming metal 3D printing, by participating in a new funding round led by Jet Investment Group, alongside AM Ventures and the European Innovation Council (EIC).

Headmade Materials tripled its sales between 2022 and 2024, serving proof to its strong position in the fast-growing additive manufacturing market. The market is estimated to grow at a rate of approximately 20% per year until 2030. The company's business model is based on selling consumables for manufacturing instead of hardware, allowing for faster scaling and recurring revenue.

"CMF technology has the potential to fundamentally transform the production of metal components by making serial 3D printing available to a wider range of industrial companies. "The funds raised represent a milestone for us on the path to further growth and expansion of applications that will accelerate the adoption of Cold Metal Fusion technology in the market."

Headmade Materials GmbH, the pioneer of ColdMetalFusion adds its self-developed and in-house manufactured binder system technology to the ColdMetalFusion Alliance for powder metallurgy, which enable customers to produce metal parts cost-effectively and in serial production. Further partners will join ColdMetalFusion later this year.

ColdMetalFusion is an alliance of industry leaders with decades of experience in the fields of sintering, 3D printing and classical industrial manufacturing. Together, the Alliance members provide services, equipment, material, software and know-how to customers in the metal manufacturing industry.

On the Formnext exhibition in November in Frankfurt, Germany, ColdMetalFusion members will demonstrate the alliance’s mission of industrialization. Headmade Material will be present on the ColdMetalFusion booth where customers can experience the newly qualified materials for the first time in hall 11.1, booth D48.
